 Most of the country would see dozens more sunrises at or after 8 a.m. if the legislation that passed the House last summer is enacted. Listen to this article 00:00 00:00 Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 31, 2026, 6:45 AM EDT By Joelle Gross The United States spans 3.8 million square miles, is home to more than 340 million people and has six time zones. When it comes to changing our clocks, one policy fits nearly all.
